# package ocpp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/ocpp"
```

Package ocpp fingerprints OCPP, the Open Charge Point Protocol spoken between electric-vehicle chargers and a charging station management system (CSMS) over WebSocket.

Detection opens a WebSocket upgrade to a charger path, offering the subprotocols ocpp2.1, ocpp2.0.1 and ocpp1.6. A CSMS completes the handshake (HTTP 101) and echoes the OCPP subprotocol it selected, which identifies both OCPP and the version negotiated; the connection is then closed without a BootNotification. A 401 with the OCPP Basic realm, or a 404 for an unknown charge-point identity, are weaker but characteristic signals.

Detect and identify behave the same: OCPP exposes no device identity before the charger sends a BootNotification, which only the charger may do. Run the fingerprinter over a TLS target (wss://) for secured CSMSs.
